Project guide

Deploy this website

The Kite documentation site is a dependency-free static application. Its Node scripts validate content, build a search index, copy public assets, and serve the result locally.

Run locally

cd website
npm run dev

Open the local address printed by the server. The site uses hash-based documentation routes, so it works from a repository subdirectory without server rewrites.

Validate and build

npm run validate
npm run build
npm test

The production output is written to:

website/dist/

GitHub Pages

The included workflow builds website/dist and deploys it with GitHub Pages.

Push the repository

Commit the website directory and .github/workflows/docs.yml.

Enable GitHub Actions as the Pages source

Open repository Settings → Pages, then select GitHub Actions under Build and deployment.

Push to main

The documentation workflow validates, builds, uploads, and deploys the static artifact.

Customize branding

FileUse
public/assets/kite-mark.svgPrimary Kite logo used in the top bar and footer.
public/assets/favicon.svgBrowser icon.
public/assets/og-card.svgSocial sharing artwork.
public/styles.cssDesign tokens, layout, typography, components, responsive behavior, and themes.
public/docs/manifest.jsonSidebar groups, routes, metadata, and search keywords.
public/docs/pages/*.htmlIndependent documentation page content.
